reader_usefulness.location: reports/current.md lines 1–341, including all seven sections, evidence notes and reference definitions; particularly lines 11–38, 78–137, 174–239 and 275–294.
reader_usefulness.basis: Read the complete frozen current report, original English brief and effective requirements. The opening gives an actionable interpretation of growth without requiring prior knowledge of Chinese business terminology. Mini-program, IP, touliu, fenzhang, baodi, beian and contractual box office are introduced at their points of use. The market-layer and denominator tables prevent the reader from treating cash top-ups, channel reach and intermediate receipts as interchangeable. Platform comparison develops repeat-access mechanisms and specific opposing cases rather than stopping at a roster: WeChat aggregation, Hongguo reward withdrawal, smaller affiliated apps and subscription-platform conditions lead to distinct operating questions. The paid waterfall and free-viewing scenarios identify recipient, base, cost and recovery priority; their sensitivity tables show why positive aggregate or platform contribution can coexist with producer losses. Existing calculation code and complete output confirm those illustrative mechanisms and the 3.12%, 10.93/15.22-day and reward-loss thresholds. Checked frozen CP25 and MD014 originals in full and the PKU contractual-production passages; their narrower observational status is preserved. The final participant table and following prose connect assets, finance and contrary evidence to choices. Necessary conditions remain adjacent to the relevant claims, and do not crowd out the causal account. References resolve through supplied definitions with page/section locators. No required reader-usefulness correction identified.
